title: Follow every link from a start page and list them

turns.prompt: Start at https://httpbin.org/links/5/0 and follow every link on that page (one level). Write the full URL of each page you reached, one per line, to {D}/links.txt, and tell me how many pages there were.
turns.verify: f={D}/links.txt; test -f $f || { echo FAIL: no links.txt; exit 0; }; u=$(grep -oE 'links/5/[0-4]' $f | sort -u | wc -l); sed 's/^/SHOW /' $f | head -8; if [ $u -ge 4 ]; then echo PASS; else echo FAIL: only $u distinct link pages; fi
